notes.title: New performance update
notes.content: Current update solves all reported performance issues in perticular related to retarting the game after respawning from the 'bad boys dungeon'.

notes.title: Drying Paint Simulator VR Release & price
notes.content:
In anticipation for the release on the 24th of January the release trailer has been published! 

[previewyoutube=6DOqgJKarD4;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to the help of some awesome BETA the last couple of bugs have been patched out in these two weeks before release, and the game is officially completely ready for release.
On the 24th the game will be published and sold for $3.99, also getting a discount of 10% until the end of the month. 

Please feel free to share your experiences and or questions in the community hub!
